title_zh: A股低于2元的股票增加到107只，几家公司股价跌破1元
title_en: Number of A-shares below 2 yuan rises to 107; several companies' share prices fall below 1 yuan

paragraphs.zh: 据第一财经报道，到11月17日，A股里收盘价不到2元的股票一共有107只。7月1日的时候，这样的股票有75只，6月1日只有50只。在这107只股票中，有9只的价格已经低于1元。
paragraphs.en: According to Yicai, as of November 17 there were 107 A-share stocks with a closing price under 2 yuan. On July 1 there were 75 such stocks, and on June 1 there were only 50. Of these 107 stocks, 9 are already priced below 1 yuan.

paragraphs.zh: 一只股票的面值一般是1元。按照交易所的规定，如果一只股票的收盘价连着20个交易日都低于1元，公司就要退市，股票不能再在股市交易。
paragraphs.en: A stock's face value is usually 1 yuan. Under the stock exchanges' rules, if a stock's closing price stays below 1 yuan for 20 trading days in a row, the company must be delisted, and its shares can no longer be traded on the stock market.

paragraphs.zh: 11月16日晚上，金科股份、山鹰国际和*ST美丽三家公司发了公告，提醒投资者有退市的风险。17日，这三只股票继续下跌，价格都在0.85元到0.87元之间。同一天，荣盛发展跌停，收盘价是0.90元，第一次低于1元。
paragraphs.en: On the evening of November 16, three companies — Jinke Properties, Shanying International and *ST Meili — issued announcements reminding investors of the risk of delisting. On the 17th, these three stocks kept falling, with prices all between 0.85 and 0.87 yuan. On the same day, Risesun Real Estate fell by the daily limit and closed at 0.90 yuan, below 1 yuan for the first time.

paragraphs.zh: 在这些低价股里，房地产公司最多，有22只，建筑装饰和钢铁公司分别有12只和10只。根据三季报，其中80家公司前三季度亏损。最近几个月，A股整体也在下跌：从7月1日到11月17日，上证指数从4112点左右降到3585点左右，跌了12.84%。11月17日，沪深两市的成交额是1.46万亿元。
paragraphs.en: Among these low-priced stocks, real estate companies are the most numerous, with 22; construction and decoration companies and steel companies have 12 and 10 respectively. According to their third-quarter reports, 80 of these companies lost money in the first three quarters. In recent months the A-share market as a whole has also been falling: from July 1 to November 17, the Shanghai Composite Index dropped from about 4,112 points to about 3,585 points, a fall of 12.84%. On November 17, turnover on the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was 1.46 trillion yuan.

vocab.en: A-shares (yuan-traded shares of companies listed in mainland China)
according to (据…报道 = according to a report by…)
face value (of a stock or banknote)
in a row; one after another
to be delisted (from a stock exchange)
to fall by the daily limit (limit-down)
the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets

glossary.en: in; at; (in the middle of doing)
Meili (part of the company name *ST Meili)
Risesun Real Estate (a Chinese property developer)

featured.note: Short for 退出市场 / 退出上市. Common collocations: 面值退市 (delisting because the price is below face value), 退市风险 (delisting risk), 强制退市 (forced delisting), 主动退市 (voluntary delisting).

examples.zh: 这家公司的股价太低，可能面临退市风险。
examples.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī de gǔjià tài dī, kěnéng miànlín tuìshì fēngxiǎn.
examples.en: This company's share price is too low, and it may face the risk of delisting.

examples.zh: 退市以后，这只股票就不能在交易所买卖了。
examples.py: Tuìshì yǐhòu, zhè zhī gǔpiào jiù bù néng zài jiāoyìsuǒ mǎimài le.
examples.en: After delisting, this stock can no longer be bought or sold on the exchange.

examples.zh: 我爸爸买的那只股票去年退市了，他很后悔。
examples.py: Wǒ bàba mǎi de nà zhī gǔpiào qùnián tuìshì le, tā hěn hòuhuǐ.
examples.en: The stock my dad bought was delisted last year, and he really regrets it.

featured.note: Opposite of 盈利 (to make a profit). Common collocations: 出现亏损 (to post a loss), 亏损扩大 (losses widen), 扭亏为盈 (to turn a loss into a profit), 净亏损 (net loss).

examples.zh: 这家银行今年第一次出现了亏损。
examples.py: Zhè jiā yínháng jīnnián dì-yī cì chūxiàn le kuīsǔn.
examples.en: This bank posted a loss for the first time this year.

examples.zh: 公司三季度亏损了五亿元，比去年多。
examples.py: Gōngsī sān jìdù kuīsǔn le wǔ yì yuán, bǐ qùnián duō.
examples.en: The company lost 500 million yuan in the third quarter, more than last year.

examples.zh: 他开的小饭馆一直亏损，最后只好关门了。
examples.py: Tā kāi de xiǎo fànguǎn yìzhí kuīsǔn, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo guānmén le.
examples.en: His little restaurant kept losing money, and in the end he had to close it.
